headline: Will Visa's (V) Job Cuts and Stablecoin Platform Launch Change Its Core Investment Narrative?
summary: Earlier this week, Visa reported fiscal third-quarter 2026 results showing net revenue of US$11.63 billion and net income of US$5.63 billion, alongside plans to cut about 2,600 jobs and continue large-scale share repurchases under an existing buyback program. At the same time, Visa launched its new Stablecoin Platform to help institutions mint, store, and move stablecoins, signaling a push to pair cost efficiencies with onchain payment innovation.
